artifacts.summary: 4-phase, 2.5-hour transcription plan: six definability declarations into OpenTruth.lean and OpenValidity.lean, README and theorem-index documentation surfaces, full verification and axiom audit.

memory_candidates.content: A docs/theorem-index.md row in this repository imposes a round-trip obligation on the declaration site that is easy to discover only at gate time: check-module-invariants.sh's second C15 assertion requires every ledger-row declaration to carry a 'Paper: <label>' line inside its own /-- doc comment, and for an unlabelled formalization-native result the value must start with '- ('. The checker walks back from the declaration over any @[...] attribute lines to the preceding -/, then to the opening /--, and requires a line matching ^\s*Paper: (.+)$ inside that block. Consequence for planning: the Paper: line must be written in the same edit as the declaration, never as a documentation afterthought, or a batch of ledger rows produces one C15 failure per row after the Lean work already looks finished. Two companion conventions travel with it: the Axioms cell abbreviates only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] as 'pcq' and writes anything else out literally (no 'p'/'pq' tokens exist), and a generated README inventory block's Description cells are hand-maintained in place while its Lines cells are generator-owned.
